preconditions: Complete and review all five DEV meetings on the final shared source identities.

Set BILLING_BOUNDS.json paid_ready=true and every other bound config to its final approved HOLD value before manifest generation. This flag records eligibility; setting it does not execute a paid request.
Set HOLD_OUT_GATE.json frozen=true as the Director's final gate value before manifest generation.

Confirm canonical PIN_MANIFEST.json does not exist. Any existing file, including invalid or stale JSON, must be preserved and requires explicit future approval plus a supersession record; --prepare-pin has no force path.
Make no bound source, config, test, runtime override, prompt, archive, audio, or annotation change after PIN generation.
Do not inspect HOLDOUT outcomes before the command succeeds.

effects: Builds a pre-pin capsule while allowing only PIN_MANIFEST.json to be absent in this preparation mode.
Generates canonical experiments/psem_r2_policy/PIN_MANIFEST.json by hashing the actual capsule runtime copies and required HOLDOUT inputs.
Builds a new capsule containing canonical RUNTIME_PIN.json and PIN_MANIFEST.json through the ordinary config overlay.
Runs holdout_unlock_error in a fresh process rooted at that final capsule and exits nonzero unless the complete manifest matches actual capsule bytes.
does_not: Set paid eligibility; paid_ready must already be true and is hashed into the PIN.
Make a network request or run HOLDOUT inference.
Overwrite or replace any existing canonical PIN_MANIFEST.json.
generate_and_validate.freeze_record: Preserve the successful command's JSON stdout outside PIN_MANIFEST.json as the freeze proof. Its pin_sha256 and fingerprint fields are the canonical manifest SHA and final capsule fingerprint; keeping them outside the PIN avoids a hash cycle.

repeat_validation.expected: Exit 0 with runtime_archive.verified=true and a manifest overlay containing both experiments/psem_r2_policy/RUNTIME_PIN.json and experiments/psem_r2_policy/PIN_MANIFEST.json.

failure_semantics: Any existing canonical PIN_MANIFEST.json, nonfinal frozen/paid eligibility config, missing required source/config/test/override/input, changed archive/prompt/runtime pin, mismatched actual capsule copy, or noncanonical interpreter exits nonzero before generation or HOLDOUT unlock. There is no force or override option.
